summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that at a July 9, 2026 special meeting, shareholders approved a proposal to amend its articles to effect one or more reverse stock splits at an exchange ratio between 1:2 and 1:250, with the board determining the timing and ratio, by January 15, 2027. This is a routine capital restructuring to boost share price, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or going-private transaction. No deal terms are present.
